groups.why_local_synthetic_e2e_cannot_prove_it: Local Synthetic E2E uses synthetic local/in-memory records and does not connect to a physical DB target.
groups.required_non_secret_value_type: masked database aliases or non-secret identifiers

groups.why_local_synthetic_e2e_cannot_prove_it: Local Synthetic E2E records supabase_connected=false and cannot identify or exclude a physical Supabase project.
groups.required_non_secret_value_type: masked Supabase/project references or explicit not-applicable basis

groups.why_local_synthetic_e2e_cannot_prove_it: No physical migration target database is accessed by the local synthetic path.
groups.required_non_secret_value_type: target DB alias, owner role and redacted reference

groups.why_local_synthetic_e2e_cannot_prove_it: No real schema is selected or read by Local Synthetic E2E.
Local synthetic tests do not capture a physical schema baseline.
groups.required_non_secret_value_type: baseline method, owner and evidence path

groups.why_local_synthetic_e2e_cannot_prove_it: Local synthetic path does not select a physical DB/Supabase RLS boundary.
groups.required_non_secret_value_type: RLS applicability and baseline evidence plan

groups.why_local_synthetic_e2e_cannot_prove_it: No physical constraints are inspected in Local Synthetic E2E.
groups.required_non_secret_value_type: constraint baseline method, owner and output path

groups.why_local_synthetic_e2e_cannot_prove_it: No physical target exists in the local synthetic evidence, so no snapshot plan is proven.
groups.required_non_secret_value_type: snapshot method, owner, non-secret storage path and restore validation plan

groups.why_local_synthetic_e2e_cannot_prove_it: Rollback depends on the physical target and execution boundary, neither of which is confirmed.
The future physical execution ledger is distinct from local synthetic audit documents.
groups.required_non_secret_value_type: repository or document path, owner and retention/access policy

groups.why_local_synthetic_e2e_cannot_prove_it: Local synthetic evidence does not grant or record approval for physical migration validation.
groups.required_non_secret_value_type: approver role/name, scope and approval record path

groups.why_local_synthetic_e2e_cannot_prove_it: Risk ownership for physical validation is a human governance value, not derivable from local synthetic tests.
groups.required_non_secret_value_type: risk owner name or role and scope

groups.why_local_synthetic_e2e_cannot_prove_it: The local evidence can state no production was used in local tests, but cannot replace a human attestation for future physical validation.
Owners, reviewers and dates require explicit human confirmation.
groups.required_non_secret_value_type: names, roles or dates without secrets
